items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: You play that and make Paul run out of wind.

ctx.x: How do you all play it? I mean I know, but I want you to tell me for the time. How do you get it?

How do we get it? Well we've got the music for it. Playing it from the music because it's not music that you can think, you've got to know it. It's got to be in you, or either you look at the notes and play it. You can't try to put two notes where one goes, not in ragtime. You've got to play it just so. They have numbers that you play in ragtime and they've got times of funeral march in it. Then you'll go to a foxtrot. Then you'll go in a blues time. All that's in one piece. And that's very complicated. That's…
